descripcion: Anionic surfactant with high detergency and foaming power, the base of many liquid and powder detergents. It is neutralized with caustic soda or other bases to form the active sulfonate of the formula. It is a reference raw material for dishwashing detergents, multipurpose detergents and degreasers for household, institutional and veterinary facility cleaning use.
formas_referenciales: Viscous liquid — amber shade variable depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Versatile anionic surfactant, valued for its foaming capacity and compatibility with other surfactants. It responds well to salt thickening, which makes it easy to formulate products of attractive viscosity at low cost. Used in dishwashing liquids, liquid soaps, shampoos and all-purpose cleaners.
formas_referenciales: Paste or viscous liquid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Anionic surfactant with abundant, fast-generating foam, with good wetting and detergent power in aqueous systems. It complements lauryl ether sulfate in formulas that require greater foam volume. Common in powder detergents, cleaning pastes and foaming products, and used as a wetting agent in solid pharmaceutical forms.
aplicaciones: Wetting excipient in tablets and powders
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or needles, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Amphoteric surfactant that boosts and stabilizes the foam of anionic systems and adds viscosity to the formula. It stands out for its compatibility with quaternary ammonium compounds, which makes it common in disinfectant cleaners. Used in dishwashing liquids, foaming cleaners and degreasers, and cleaning products with cationic biocides.
formas_referenciales: Aqueous liquid — transparent to slightly hazy, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Nonionic surfactant with excellent wetting and degreasing power and low sensitivity to hard water. It is the base of industrial degreasers and liquid detergents aimed at greasy soils. Its nonionic character makes it easy to combine with anionic and cationic surfactants in the same formula.
formas_referenciales: Liquid to paste, depending on the degree of ethoxylation, manufacturer, and temperature

descripcion: Classic thickener and foam stabilizer for anionic surfactant systems. It provides body and superfatting to liquid detergents and dishwashing liquids, and helps maintain foam in the presence of greasy soil. Traditional raw material in cleaning, personal care and hygiene products for pharmaceutical and veterinary use.
formas_referenciales: Viscous liquid — amber shade varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Nonionic surfactant derived from glucose and fatty alcohols, with a good biodegradability profile. It provides wetting and detergency with low harshness and is stable in strongly alkaline media. Used in cleaners with an eco-friendly positioning, alkaline degreasers, and personal care formulas.
formas_referenciales: Viscous liquid — yellow to amber tone depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Anionic surfactant with good detergency and stable foam even in hard water. It works as an alternative or complement to linear sulfonate in powder and liquid detergents. Also used in economy shampoos and foaming cleaning products.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — aqueous solution, depending on the manufacturer's grade
Solid — powder or needles, depending on the presentation and batch

descripcion: Quaternary ammonium compound widely used as an active ingredient in disinfectant and sanitizing formulations for surfaces. It also provides cationic surfactant properties and an antistatic effect in the formula. Its use in disinfection is carried out in accordance with applicable health regulations.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — aqueous solution, depending on the grade and manufacturer

descripcion: Twin-chain quaternary ammonium compound used as a biocidal active in surface disinfectants, alone or blended with benzalkonium chloride. Associated with good performance in the presence of organic matter and hard water. Its use is subject to applicable health regulations.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — solution, depending on the grade and manufacturer

descripcion: Oxidizing agent used as a bleach and as an active in disinfectant and sanitizing formulations. It decomposes into water and oxygen, which makes it attractive in low-residue formulas. In cosmetics it is used as an oxidant in hair bleaching and coloring products, and in institutional cleaning, laundry and industrial processes in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Colorless liquid — aqueous solution, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Potent oxidizer used as a sanitizer in the food and beverage industry and in institutional disinfection. It acts at low temperature and degrades into by-products with low environmental impact. It is also used in the sanitization of equipment and surfaces in cosmetic, pharmaceutical and nutraceutical plants, in accordance with applicable regulations and the manufacturer's recommendations.
aplicaciones: CIP sanitization in foods and beverages
Sanitization of cosmetic and pharmaceutical plants
formas_referenciales: Liquid — equilibrium solution, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Most widely used source of active chlorine in liquid bleaches and disinfectants of the household and institutional type. Base raw material for commercial bleaches, chlorinated cleaners and water treatment applications. The available chlorine content varies with time and storage conditions, so it is recommended to check the batch certificate of analysis.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — aqueous solution, depending on the manufacturer and batch; concentration varies with storage

descripcion: Organic source of stabilized chlorine, valued for its ease of dosing and its good storage stability. It releases active chlorine in a controlled manner when dissolved in water. Used in surface disinfectants, emergency water purification, and institutional sanitization, in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — granules or tablets, depending on the manufacturer's presentation and batch

descripcion: Aldehyde used as a biocidal active in institutional, agro-industrial and veterinary disinfectants. Common in blends with quaternary ammonium compounds to broaden the spectrum of action of the formula. Its use is subject to applicable health regulations and to the manufacturer's handling recommendations.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — colorless to pale yellow aqueous solution, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Isothiazolinone blend used as a broad-spectrum preservative to protect detergents, liquid soaps and aqueous cleaners throughout their shelf life. Associated with in-pack protection against bacteria, fungi and yeasts at low use levels. Its use in cosmetics is limited to rinse-off products, in line with applicable regulations.
aplicaciones: Shampoos and bath gels (according to regulations)
formas_referenciales: Liquid — transparent to slightly yellow, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Fundamental alkali of the cleaning industry: it saponifies fats, neutralizes sulfonic acids, and adjusts the pH of all kinds of formulas. It is the base of heavy-duty degreasers, drain openers, and CIP cleaners in the food industry. A high-turnover raw material in soap and detergent manufacturing.
formas_referenciales: Solid — flakes, pearls, or micropearls, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Liquid — aqueous solution, depending on availability

descripcion: Highly soluble alkali used in the manufacture of liquid and potassium soaps, degreasers, and industrial cleaners. It produces soaps that are more soluble and faster to saponify than those made with caustic soda. Also used for pH adjustment in concentrated liquid formulas.
formas_referenciales: Solid — flakes or pearls, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Liquid — aqueous solution, depending on availability

descripcion: Alkaline builder that provides alkalinity, degreasing power, and soil dispersion in powder and liquid detergents. It helps protect sensitive metal surfaces during alkaline cleaning. Used in industrial degreasers, detergents for mechanical dishwashing, and high-pH cleaners.
formas_referenciales: Solid — granules or powder, in pentahydrate or anhydrous grade depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Classic detergency builder: it sequesters water hardness, disperses soil, and helps prevent its redeposition onto fabrics. It boosts surfactant performance in powder detergents, liquid detergents, and institutional cleaners. Its incorporation is subject to local regulations on phosphates.
formas_referenciales: Solid — granules or powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Solid active-oxygen bleach that releases hydrogen peroxide when dissolved in water. It is the base of active-oxygen stain removers, laundry boosters, and detergents with built-in bleach. Active at moderate temperatures, especially in combination with bleach activators.
formas_referenciales: Solid — granules, coated or uncoated depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Inorganic salt used as a filler and flow agent in powder detergents, and as a viscosity regulator in liquid anionic surfactant systems. It adds volume and flowability to the finished product at low cost. A standard raw material in the detergent industry and in textile dyeing.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Reference chelating agent in detergency: it sequesters calcium, magnesium and transition metals that interfere with surfactants and bleaches. It improves formula performance in hard water and contributes to stability. Used in liquid detergents, alkaline cleaners and institutional products; also in cosmetics and, in line with applicable regulations, in pharmaceutical, veterinary, nutraceutical and food preparations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Liquid — aqueous solution, depending on availability

descripcion: Chelating agent of biotechnological origin with very good performance in strongly alkaline media, where it sequesters calcium and iron. Owing to its biodegradability, it is an alternative to phosphates and EDTA in alkaline cleaners. Used in degreasers and high-pH cleaners and, in line with applicable regulations, as a chelating agent in cosmetics, veterinary products and supplements.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Enzyme that breaks down protein-based stains such as blood, egg, milk, and sweat during laundry washing. It makes it possible to formulate well-performing detergents at low temperatures, reducing the energy consumption of washing. Used in powder detergents, liquid detergents, and enzymatic pre-wash products.
formas_referenciales: Solid — encapsulated granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Liquid — enzyme concentrate, depending on availability

descripcion: Fluorescent whitening agent that absorbs ultraviolet light and re-emits it as visible blue light, improving the perception of whiteness of fabrics and surfaces. It is a classic component of laundry detergents for whites and is also used in plastics. The type of brightener is selected according to the substrate and the application process.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granulate, depending on the type, manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Cationic active for fabric softeners, with a more favorable biodegradability profile than that of traditional quaternary compounds. It provides softness, static control, and ease of ironing to fabrics. It is the base of the concentrated and diluted fabric softeners on today's market.
formas_referenciales: Solid — pastilles or flakes, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Paste to viscous liquid depending on the grade and temperature
